blurb: Cedar Hills Golf Club is a 6,600 yard, 18-hole, par 71 championship golf course nestled at the mouth of American Fork Canyon. The course features varied topography and natural landscaping with native grasses and lace-edged bunkers. Designed by Graves & Pascuzzo, it offers a challenging but enjoyable round for golfers of all abilities.
extraNote: Book your re-round time 2 ½ hours after the 1st booking
